name: De Stijl
garments: not a fashion look — painting, furniture and architecture

media.title: Piet Mondrian, Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow (1930)
media.note: the defining image of the style's reduced palette

reacts_against: representational art and decorative ornament entirely, reducing painting to horizontal and vertical lines and the three primary colors plus black, white and grey.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Straight horizontal and vertical lines, squares and rectangles, asymmetry, geometric abstraction, dynamic equilibrium
wiki_facts.key_colours: Primary colors (red, blue, yellow) and non-colors (white, black, gray)
wiki_facts.key_values: Pure abstraction, spiritual harmony, universality, order, reduction to essentials, utopian social vision, integration of art and life

findings: light — about 47% of the measured color is pale or near-white
mostly muted — about 64% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
